clauses.title: CL-D76 records that the cleanup builder takes its cwd from the receipt
clauses.section: ## CL-D76 — The cleanup builder takes its cwd from the receipt
requires: the packaged CLI and the builder itself both refuse a `cwd` as an unknown request field
the one `workspace_cleanup` holds against the stored receipt
That choice between the two copies is this record's reading of the owner's decision, not a further owner choice
Accepting a caller-stated cwd in the builder again, or deriving it from anything but the stored creation identity, requires a new owner decision
key order included because the operation compares the stored identity as JSON
they are known residuals of this record, not defects of the builder

clauses.title: The builder-derived cleanup cwd is pinned by its own regression
requires: Issue #142 the cleanup builder takes the repository from the receipt, and the request it builds removes the workspace
Issue #142 the cleanup builder accepts no cwd, the workspace included
Issue #142 a receipt whose repository is the workspace is still refused before any request exists
Issue #142 the unchecked copy beside the stored identity does not choose the cwd
Issue #142 a receipt string the filesystem cannot take is refused at build, never certified (ADV-144-INVALID-REPOSITORY-NUL, ADV-144-UNCHECKED-REQUEST-PATHS)
Issue #142 the cwd is judged against the workspace the receipt states, the one the operation compares
Issue #142 an absent or non-string receipt path is refused in the boundary vocabulary, not as a crash (ADV-144-RECEIPT-PATH-TYPE)
Issue #142 a stored identity field of the wrong type, or missing, is refused at build (pre-push pass on ab05722)
Issue #142 a receipt nested beyond any genuine one, or with an unusable key, is refused at build
